credentialCheckPerformed.methodology: The codebase's OWN documented credential-resolution order was used as the authority for what counts as 'an authorized model credential' (lib/extraction/get-provider.ts's getExtractionProvider(), which is the canonical selection logic this repository already uses in production): (1) AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, (2) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Both were checked directly in the running shell environment, not assumed.
checksRun: env | grep -iE "anthropic|claude|openai|api_key" - no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, or OPENAI_API_KEY present

Full env scan for any key/token/secret/credential-shaped variable name: only CLAUDE_CODE_* session-management tokens (the harness's own OAuth token for running this CLI session, not a general-purpose model API credential usable from arbitrary evaluator code), GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN (source control), and AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY were present

Confirmed the codebase has NO Bedrock/AWS-hosted-model provider implementation anywhere (grep -rli bedrock|AWS_ACCESS_KEY|@aws-sdk across lib/ and package.json returned zero matches) - so the AWS credentials present are not a usable path to a Claude/Anthropic model call under this repository's own architecture and are not assumed to be one.

@anthropic-ai/sdk is present in node_modules (a normal dependency of the codebase's own provider files) but an SDK package is not itself a credential - without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY it cannot make an authenticated call.
credentialCheckPerformed.conclusion: No authorized model credential (AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, per this repository's own canonical selection order) is available in this execution environment. This is the same conclusion Phase 3F.1.5's Agent 1 independently reached in the same kind of sandboxed environment; this phase re-verified it directly rather than assuming it carried over unchanged.

phaseCharterInstructionApplied: Section 7 of the Phase 3F.1.5.1 charter: 'This phase requires an authorized model credential. If no credential is available: STOP. Return: PHASE_3F_1_5_1_EVALUATION_CALIBRATION_ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED. Do not claim the phase passed using mocks alone.'
actionTaken: STOP, per the charter's explicit instruction. No live semantic judge call was made. No mock, scripted responder, or synthetic stand-in was substituted for a live model and none of the downstream artifacts (05 through 12) claim to represent a real rerun.

downstreamSectionsAffected.section9_10_newProtocolAndSample: DESIGNED but NOT EXECUTED - see 05-second-pass-protocol.json and 06-frozen-sample.json, both explicitly marked as forward-looking specifications ready for a future unblocked iteration, not as records of an actual rerun.
downstreamSectionsAffected.section11_agreementComputation: PRE-REGISTERED FORMULA RESTATED, NOT APPLIED to any new data - see 07-preregistered-agreement-computation.json.
downstreamSectionsAffected.section12_rerunExecution: NOT_EXECUTED for the reason stated above.
downstreamSectionsAffected.section13_falseCreditRegression: EXECUTED - this does NOT require a live judge; it is a deterministic re-verification that the 14 known false credits and the existing test suites still hold with zero code changes. See 09-known-false-credit-regression.json and 10-adversarial-regression.json.
